plan: Rebuilt after attempt 1 lost 6-1. Lorenzo's two leads are a Life Orb Ogerpon whose Ivy Cudgel and Horn Leech are Grass, and a Toxic Boost Zangoose whose Facade and Close Combat are Normal and Fighting. My Water/Ground and Steel/Ground core was 2x or 4x to all four of those moves. This party inverts that: Mega Charizard Y, Togekiss and Dragonite all take Grass at 0.25x and Fighting at 0.25x-0.5x, Heat Wave and Air Slash are both 2x into Ogerpon, Magnezone's Thunderbolt is 2x into Starmie and Excadrill's Earthquake is 2x into Nidoqueen. The trade is that Nidoqueen's Ice Beam and Starmie's Thunderbolt are 2x into three of my six, so the back half of the fight is the dangerous part.
